As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial c... 1 Research Engineer (f/m/d) for Electric Vehicle Power Electronics (Temporary position, initially limited to 1 year) on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week)

 * You work in national and European funded projects, contributing to the development of next generation power electronics.
 * You apply your expertise as a BMS and power electronics developer for topology and component selection, circuit design, and hardware/software implementation.
 * You develop and integrate hardware/software for battery management systems, traction inverters, onboard chargers, as well as DC/DC converters, and commission them.
 * You engage in programming BMS control and SOX algorithms for the operation of battery storage systems.
 * You simulate energy flow and electrical circuits and optimise power electronics in terms of efficiency, power density, and reliability.

 * You write impactful scientific publications and present them at national and international conferences.
 * You contribute to the development of novel methods and prototypes for our industry partners and help therefore to design better, faster, and sustainable products.
 * You give input for new strategic research ideas, that will contribute to the growth of our unit's research project portfolio.
 * Through your input for new strategic research ideas, innovative results and customer-oriented approach, you will contribute to the success of our current research project portfolio and support our industry partners to roll out their new products to the market.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering and/or Technical Physics
 * Profound knowledge in Power Electronics, Electric Drives and Battery Storage Systems
 * Experience in the development of BMS systems and algorithms
 * Several years of work experience ideally in the context of electric vehicles and battery storage systems
 * Experience in independently managing (research) projects
 * Excellent proficiency in relevant tools (MATLAB, C++, Python, EAGLE, PSIM, LTSpice, PLECS, etc.)
 * Hands-on mentality and a passion for creating sustainable technical solutions
 * Analytical thinking and enthusiasm for highly innovative research
 * Communication and team working skills in English and best in German
 * Communication and written skills in English; German is highly preferred.

What to expect:

 * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, pension fund, additional days off for various life events, family benefits (including two weeks of paid paternity leave "Papa-Weeks" and leisure subsidies), voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events and many more, as well as flexitime models (incl. up to 50% home office), travel support for conferences and networking, and individual training and career development opportunities.
